africActive

Regular Show Quote of the Day

A daily quote generator pulling lines from the animated series Regular Show from an original corpus I constructed. Built for fans who want their daily dose of Mordecai and Rigby (and every other character).
Website

Where To Watch NBA

A quick-lookup tool that tells you which streaming service carries your favorite NBA team's games. Built for NBA fans like myself who got fed up with never knowing where to watch nationally-televised games.
Website

DocSearchBuddy

A document search utility that makes it easier to find what you need across technical docs and references quickly.

Games

Game

MINTGAME 2

The sequel to a demo game following the door-to-door discoveries of a mint salesman, this game is a narrative-driven open-world adventure developed in Unity and published on itch.io.
Game

SONOdream

A music-based 2D platformer with puzzle elements created as part of a team of 3 developers in Unity and published on itch.io. Featuring original music produced by me!
Game

An unsettling horror experience based on an elevator, developed in Unreal Engine as part of the Ludem Dare 57 game jam.
Game

Game

PizzaVR

A VR game featuring pizza delivery, non-nauseous rope-slinging movement, and a bustling city developed in Unity. Check out the demo on YouTube.
